title: Defining Venus, a high-fidelity companion robot
result: Product scope and acceptance criteria defined
summary: Turned user research and channel observations into product priorities, interaction scenarios and acceptance criteria.
context: The team needed to turn a broad consumer hardware concept into a defined companion robot product for further development.
decisions: I combined user interviews, co-creation surveys and channel research in Japan. I translated interaction needs into separate requirements for local motion, voice and cloud conversation, including criteria for latency, synchronization and noise.
outcome: The work delivered a product proposal with target segments, priority scenarios and scope, alongside device-update requirements and after-sales cost estimates.
